turnos.t: Is a stakeholder the same as a shareholder?
No. A stakeholder is any individual or group with an interest in a business, because they affect it or are affected by it. Shareholders own shares, so they're just one type of stakeholder.

Internal stakeholders are part of the organization: employees, managers and owners. External ones are outside but affected: customers, suppliers, the government, the local community. To explain any reaction, start from what that group wants.
